summary: SiteDocument represents a document belonging to a site, with identifiers for the document and the site.
purpose: To provide a data structure for site-related documents and manage their association with sites in the system.
system_behavior: SiteDocument is a simple entity used for linking documents to specific sites.
content_gaps: No workflow or business rules provided. No actor or field-level validation logic found.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin handles the welcome page shown to staff administrators, providing information about last login, error/warning messages, site and discipline selection, filtering, and a grid view of employment applications.
purpose: To display administrative welcome information to staff, allow filtering of employment applications by site/discipline/dates, and show relevant error/warning panels.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: StaffAdmin selects site and discipline filters.
StaffAdmin enters start and end dates.
StaffAdmin clicks refresh to update grid view.
Employment applications are displayed and filtered.
Grid view shows application details including name, program, site, status, and withdrawn date.
Error and warning panels are displayed if needed.

business_rules: Show withdrawn applications if checkbox is checked.
Require start and end dates via validators.
Start date must be before end date (custom validator).
Email links shown only if data.Email is present.
Status shown as 'Submitted' unless WithdrawnDate is present; then show 'Withdrawn'.
conditions: Show error and warning panels only when content is present.
Withdrawn applications shown if 'Show withdrawn applications' checkbox is checked.
system_behavior: Page loads with default filter values and populates dropdowns.
Grid view updates with employment applications based on filtering criteria.
Handles postback and client-side JavaScript for UI interactions.
content_gaps: Details of error/warning message handling omitted.
Field descriptions and business logic for employment applications not fully included.

summary: ServiceCode defines a code used for categorizing services, including identifiers, names, notes, sort orders, and alternate language fields.
purpose: To provide a standardized data structure for service categorization and retrieval, supporting multiple languages.

workflows.name: ServiceCode Retrieval
steps: ServiceCodeListAll retrieves all service codes for a session.
ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID retrieves service codes for a course.
ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID retrieves service codes for a timetable.
Localize alters Name if alternate-language mode is set.

business_rules: If alternate-language mode is enabled (sess.UseAltLanguageFields), use NameAlt for Name.
system_behavior: ServiceCode and ServiceCodes provide static data retrieval and localization logic.
content_gaps: No actor or validation logic provided.
Business logic for notes and sorting omitted.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks changes made to site profiles, recording action dates, user info, section and field details, agency, and phone.
purpose: To record the history of changes made to site profiles, supporting auditing and review.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: User triggers history search for a site.
System executes stored procedure SiteProfileHistorySearch.
Result list is populated with SiteProfileHistory entries.
Each entry includes details about the change, who performed it, and when.

business_rules: If ByUserSysAdmin is false and ByUserID != ByOriginalUserID, add 'Support Team for' to formatted user display.
Show user details with formatted name, agency, and phone.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted returns formatted user info based on rules.
system_behavior: Records change history for site profiles, supporting auditing.
Supports alternate language fields for ScreenSection, UserAction, and Fields.
content_gaps: No business rule for modification restrictions. Actor roles besides SysAdmin/User not detailed.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents documents used in email popups, including file name, path, checked status, and ID. EmailPopupDocuments allows searching and deletion management.
purpose: To manage and provide documents to be sent in email popups, allowing for their retrieval and deletion.

workflows.name: Search EmailPopupDocuments
steps: System receives DataInfo string.
DataInfo is split by |, then each item is split by >.
If there are 2 items, a new EmailPopupDocument is created and added to the list.

workflows.name: Delete EmailPopupDocument
steps: Given DataInfo and ID, system locates entry.
If entry found, attempts to delete file and directory.
Returns updated DataInfo string.

conditions: Check for empty DataInfo before processing.
system_behavior: Manages file and directory deletion for email popup documents.
Parses file data from DataInfo and constructs document entries.
exceptions: Deletion attempts are wrapped in try-catch (failure is silently ignored).
content_gaps: No actor or business rule described. No explicit validation or error messaging logic.
